visual_action: Barack Obama and Raphael Warnock stand together in front of a brick wall covered with campaign posters. The posters read "ONE MORE TIME GEORGIA" and "VOTE WARNOCK." Both men speak directly to the camera.

cast.name: Barack Obama
cast.evidence: Barack Obama appears on screen and introduces himself, saying, "Georgia, this is Barack Obama."

cast.name: Raphael Warnock
cast.evidence: Raphael Warnock appears on screen and is endorsed by Barack Obama, who says, "vote for Senator Raphael Warnock." On-screen text also says, "let's vote for Senator Warnock!"

on_screen_text.text: Georgia, let's vote for Senator Warnock! 🗳️
It is time for us to get out there
and vote for Senator Raphael Warnock.
to find your polling location and vote early.

spoken_summary: Barack Obama introduces himself and tells Georgians it's time to vote for Senator Raphael Warnock. Warnock adds a call to action, directing viewers to "IWillVote.com to find your polling location and vote early." Obama concludes with "Let's get it done."
audio_music: The audio consists entirely of dialogue from the two speakers, with some faint, indistinct background chatter suggesting they are at an event. There is no music or other score.
editing_pacing: The video is a single, static shot with no cuts or camera movement.
central_claim: With an endorsement from former President Barack Obama, Georgia voters should go out and vote for Senator Raphael Warnock.
intended_effect: To mobilize Georgia voters to support Raphael Warnock by leveraging Barack Obama's endorsement and providing a clear call to action.
